notes: Reactions you make yourself: when a gift, follow or share comes in, show a source, play a video or a sound for as long as you set. The Reactions tab lists every reaction, imported or your own, with a Test button, an on/off switch and a Key box to fire one from a Stream Deck key. Triggers: a gift by name, any gift, a gift worth N coins or more, a follow, a share, a like goal, a chat command, or a key only. Your own reactions stay when you import from TikFinity again.
